context.body: At Sinai, Israel is reminded of deliverance and told that hearing God’s voice and keeping covenant is connected with treasured possession, priestly kingdom, and holy nation language.

observations.body: The scene places covenant response after rescue from Egypt, before the covenant words are publicly ratified.

payload.posture: Read Exodus 19:1–8 as its own sinai covenant setting before carrying its language into another source.
